root_cause: Parse5 correctly serializes ampersands in title text and meta attributes as &. The locale validator compared raw serialized strings against unescaped source values, creating false mismatches on English titles and keyword clusters such as M&A and AI Model Comparison & Selector.
prevention: Decode HTML character references before semantic metadata comparison.
Keep serialization correctness separate from SEO-value correctness.
Regression coverage includes named and numeric character references.
fix: Decode named and numeric HTML entities in validator attribute/title extraction before comparing against the locale revenue map.
